title: Minecraft ULTIMATE Super Smelter 1.21 - INFINITE FUEL - 17,280 Items P/H!
description:
Hello Everybody, TheySix is here With a New Minecraft Tutorial, In This Video I Will Show you how to make a Simple Easy Super Fast Smelter With Infinite Fuel In Minecraft 1.21

⭕This Super Smelter is a new version of the last super smelter ( What's New?! ) :
❌Chest & Boat Minecart is removed due to some problems ( on 1.20.2 )
❌ The length of the smelter is extended 
❌ Speed of smelting is increased ( Speed of fuel and Items spreading )
❌ Increased Size of output
❌ Rail formations have changed

📚This super smelter is simple easy to build and can smelt 30k items Per Hour!!! 
📚Also This design is expandable and you can expand it as much as you like!
📚It's optional but you can build a carpet duper for this smelter and connect it to the smelter for the infinite fuel source!!
📚also if you want to extend the smelter or make the fuel system faster you can add another carpet duper on the other sides of the smelter but if you extended the smelter it's important to add one!
📚The carpet duper should be bigger ( 3 pistons in total ) and if you are making a smelter bigger than the normal size ( 3x or higher ) make sure to add 3 carpet dupers in total and divide the smelter in 3 sections
📚The carpet duper only works on the java edition also its will not work on paper mc servers there is conditions that you can turn off this limitation if you have access to server files

I Hope Enjoy My Video !!🙏🥰🥰
